messages.content: Include exactly 5 numbers in the response. For a generative AI system, suppose a generated output is substantially similar to an item in the training dataset. Does this prove that the training dataset item was memorized?

message.content: No. A single instance of substantial similarity does not prove memorization. Generative AI systems can produce similar outputs through at least 2 mechanisms: convergence on common patterns, or interpolation between training examples. In practice, researchers often evaluate memorization by requiring at least 3 consecutive tokens to match verbatim. Even when a 4th metric—such as exact sequence length of 50 tokens—is applied, this remains debated, and the phenomenon is more accurately described as a spectrum rather than a binary condition with 5 possible degrees of overlap.
